purpose: Ramp/ground pairings below the APCA body-text threshold that ALREADY ship. R1-P extended the ramp check to compiled mode blocks, which is what made them visible; an architecture wave may not repaint them silently, so they are recorded here instead. Decrease-only: a pairing not on this list fails the build, and an entry that stops failing may simply be deleted.
retire: sighted mode-palette work (R2/R3) gives each dark state a ramp derived against its own ground, at which point the -900 step stops being invisible and the entry is removed
